services.description: Manage subscriptions billed through Google Play.
steps: Sign in with the Google Account that paid

sourceLinks.title: Google Play Help — Cancel or change a subscription

services.notes: In the Play Store app, open your profile menu, then Payments & subscriptions, then Subscriptions. If the subscription is missing, switch to the Google Account shown on your receipt or check which company billed you. Removing an app leaves its subscription active.

services.description: Manage subscriptions billed by Apple, including App Store purchases.
steps: Sign in with the Apple Account shown on your receipt
Follow the prompts to find the subscription

sourceLinks.title: Apple Support — Cancel a subscription from Apple
Google Play Help — Cancel or change a subscription

services.notes: On iPhone or iPad, open Settings, tap your name, and open Subscriptions. If you paid for Apple Music or Apple TV through Google Play, manage it in your Google Play subscriptions.

services.description: Open the Netflix cancellation page or find your billing partner.

sourceLinks.title: Netflix Help Center — How to cancel Netflix

services.notes: If Netflix does not show a cancellation option, check the Membership section of your account for the billing partner and follow its instructions. Your account page shows when your access ends.

services.description: Cancel Disney+ from your account or through the company that bills you.
steps: Sign in to Disney+ in a browser
Open your profile and choose Account
Choose Cancel Subscription and follow the prompts

sourceLinks.title: Disney+ Help Center — How to cancel Disney+

services.notes: For subscriptions or bundles billed by another company, use that provider’s cancellation process. Check which plan you selected before confirming if you have more than one subscription.

services.description: Manage or cancel your Spotify Premium plan.
steps: Sign in to your Spotify account

sourceLinks.title: Spotify Support — How to cancel Premium plans

services.notes: If you pay through a partner, look under Payment for the partner’s contact information. If you belong to a Family or Duo plan, only the plan manager can cancel the whole plan.

services.description: Manage YouTube Premium or YouTube Music Premium.
steps: Continue to cancel and follow the prompts

sourceLinks.title: YouTube Help — Cancel Premium in a browser
YouTube Help — Cancel Premium in the Android app

services.notes: In the Android app, open your profile picture, choose Paid memberships, select the membership, and tap Continue to cancel. Follow the prompts and confirm. If Apple or Google Play bills you, use that store’s subscription settings.

services.description: Find cancellation steps for a ChatGPT plan based on where you paid.
steps: Sign in to ChatGPT in a browser
Open your account menu and choose Settings

sourceLinks.title: OpenAI Help Center — Canceling your ChatGPT subscription

services.notes: The steps above apply to personal plans purchased on chatgpt.com. Cancel at least 24 hours before the next billing date to avoid another charge. Use the store that billed you for App Store or Google Play purchases. Manage self-service ChatGPT Business plans in workspace billing settings.

services.description: Manage your Google One storage membership.

sourceLinks.title: Google One Help — Cancel your Google One membership

services.notes: In the Android app, open Menu, then Settings to find Cancel membership. If Apple bills you, manage the subscription through Apple. Check your storage usage before canceling because your account storage limit may decrease.

services.description: Manage the Google AI plan that powers paid Gemini features.
steps: Open Google One settings with the account that pays for your plan

sourceLinks.title: Gemini Apps Help — Manage your Google AI plan

services.notes: In the Gemini app, open Menu, tap your profile picture or initial, and select Manage subscriptions to reach Google One settings. Review the storage and other benefits attached to your plan before you confirm.

services.description: Find cancellation steps for a paid personal Claude plan.
steps: Sign in to Claude in a browser
Choose Cancel and follow the prompts

sourceLinks.title: Claude Help Center — Cancel your Pro, Max, or Ultra subscription

services.notes: For an Android purchase, tap your initials in Claude, open Billing, and select Manage subscription. You can also cancel through the store that billed you. Claude advises canceling at least 24 hours before your next billing date.

services.description: Find the cancellation path for the company that bills your Life360 membership.
steps: Open Life360 and go to Settings
Complete cancellation with the billing provider

sourceLinks.title: Life360 Help Center — Cancel My Membership

services.notes: For web purchases, sign in to Life360, open Manage Membership, and choose Cancel Subscription. For App Store or Google Play purchases, use the subscription settings for that store.

services.description: Cancel a Finelo membership from your profile or the app store that billed you.

sourceLinks.title: Finelo Support Center — How do I unsubscribe?

services.notes: Use your Finelo profile for a purchase made on its website. For purchases billed by an app store, use that store’s subscription controls. Look for a confirmation message after you cancel.

services.description: Cancel Telegram Premium through the store or bot that billed you.
steps: Check your receipt to find who billed you
Open that store’s subscription settings or @PremiumBot
Choose Telegram Premium and cancel, or send /stop to @PremiumBot

sourceLinks.title: Telegram Premium FAQ — How can I cancel my subscription?
Google Play Help — Cancel or change a subscription
Apple Support — Cancel a subscription from Apple

services.notes: The website link opens Google Play subscriptions. If you bought Premium from @PremiumBot, send /stop in the bot chat. For Apple purchases, use Apple Subscriptions. Uninstalling Telegram leaves your subscription active.

services.description: Manage an Adobe plan or trial from your Adobe account.
steps: Sign in to your Adobe account
Select Manage plan for the right subscription

sourceLinks.title: Adobe Help — Cancel an Adobe trial or subscription

services.notes: Review any cancellation fee shown before confirming. If you paid through another company, use its cancellation process. If you have several Adobe plans, check each one separately.

services.description: Manage a personal or family Microsoft 365 subscription.
steps: Sign in to the Microsoft account that paid
Choose the cancellation option and follow the prompts

sourceLinks.title: Microsoft Support — Cancel your Microsoft subscription

services.notes: If the page offers Turn on recurring billing, auto-renewal is already off. If an app store or retailer billed your plan, contact that provider for cancellation.

services.description: Cancel Game Pass or turn off recurring billing from your Microsoft account.
steps: Sign in to the Microsoft account you use for Xbox
Find Game Pass and choose Manage
Choose Cancel subscription or turn off recurring billing

sourceLinks.title: Xbox Support — Cancel a subscription or turn off recurring billing
Microsoft Support — Cancel your Microsoft subscription

services.notes: Turning off recurring billing lets the subscription expire at the end of the paid period. Check your account page for the expiration date.

services.description: Turn off automatic renewal for Nintendo Switch Online.
steps: Sign in with the Nintendo Account that purchased the membership
Select the option to turn off auto-renewal

sourceLinks.title: Nintendo Support — Cancel or manage automatic renewal

services.notes: To prevent renewal, turn it off at least 48 hours before your membership expires. You can also manage it from the Nintendo eShop on a Switch console.
